environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door with default routing. Static files middleware serves /uploads/ directory directly with no additional Content-Security-Policy headers. The Preview page renders uploaded JavaScript files via <script> tags without integrity attributes. No WAF policy attached to the Front Door profile. X-Content-Type-Options header is not set, allowing MIME sniffing.

config.front_door: Azure Front Door Standard, no WAF policy
